composite_card.title: Square-output to paired forward-walk/replay f-term transport with source-indexed strip proof

lifecycle.path: IDEA -> SCOPED (current) -> MODELED only after the bit-use/certificate model closes -> CHEAP_PROBE only after isolated implementer dispatch -> CANDIDATE only if every staged discriminator passes
lifecycle.not_a_ceiling: No bounded dependency or two-surface rejection establishes a family-wide ceiling. This is a new cross-cell transport question, not a reopening of codec-local Q tuning, SQ-01 early unbuild, or traversal-count reduction.

composite_card.search_radius: A source-indexed subset of the five NAF f-correction terms emitted by square.rs::apply_shifted_hi_term during square_b_hi_apply_f_times_sub and square_c_sum_apply_shifted_128_sub, across the ec_add x2 handoff into gcd.rs::mod_mul_inverse_in_place(Direction::Forward), its first forward divstep/truncation and paired reverse replay, codec dialog ownership, and the final deep-strip occurrence table. The card permits no retained b_hi/product register, no tape widening, no traversal-count change, no SCHED_J2 width change, and no reuse of EXP-SQ-01's early-unbuild patch.
composite_card.mechanism: Test a stronger, paired condition than SQ-04's local dead-bit conjecture: for a selected correction control/value slice, prove that its only pre-output influence is a first-forward-walk input slice which is canonically transported into already-existing dialog/replay state, then move the correction through that forward/reverse boundary and restore it at the paired replay boundary. The intended saving is deletion of the now-redundant correction/uncompute pair or a source-proven CCX-to-CX downgrade; merely moving an equal-cost correction is not success. The certificate must prove that no selected bit fans into a branch, swap predicate, dialog symbol, carry, later output, or phase operation before restoration. This co-design deliberately uses existing state only: retaining b_hi/product controls across the walk, allocating a new tape bit, or widening a cswap is disallowed because those alternatives reopen the known Q/traversal failures.

predicted_direction.score: Estimate only: -577,000 to -2,308,000 at fixed Q=1,154 if T saves 500 to 2,000; no score claim until exact 9,024-shot evaluation with a stream-bound nonce.
predicted_direction.lambda: 0 expected only for a bit-exact certificate and no new Hmr/R/phase site. It is not measured and must be paired against the frontier lambda 17.62 before any candidate classification.

composite_card.emitted_to_executed_discount_assumptions: The -500..-2,000 range is not a gate-count promise. Square build/unbuild is nearly fully executed; square applies have about a 3% discount in the SQ-01 vent probe, while conditioned clean phases can have a 50% discount. Price a removed selected f-term at its phase-local TRACE_TLM_TOF ratio, price a deletion-induced strip loss at approximately one executed T per stale key only as a provisional tax, and do not credit a relocated equal-cost gate pair. The score estimate assumes Q stays 1,154 and uses 1,154*d(round(T)).

paired_invariants_and_proof_obligation.invariant_pair_1: Walk/replay pair: the modified first-forward step and its matching reverse replay step are exact inverses on (xv, y, dialog, phase). The exact same selected slice must be restored at the paired boundary; one-sided forward deletion is forbidden.
paired_invariants_and_proof_obligation.invariant_pair_2: s2 pair: both the divstep walk and Bezout replay preserve the existing s2-conditionality and the coupling s = SCHED_J2[i] - cmp_window(i). No selected term may change a conditional predicate or its tape symbol in only one direction.
paired_invariants_and_proof_obligation.invariant_pair_3: Arithmetic/liveness pair: x2 is reduced mod p at the square exit and has the original value before forward-output observation; no b_hi/product/extra dialog state remains live after its old lifetime, and all scratch returns to zero with zero residual phase.
paired_invariants_and_proof_obligation.invariant_pair_4: Strip/proof pair: each removed or downgraded gate carries a source-level bit-use/UNSAT or affine-wire certificate independent of occurrence ordinal; the changed final stream still passes the occupancy tripwire, and every unproven affected statistical key is omitted pending re-mine.
paired_invariants_and_proof_obligation.proof_obligation: Produce a machine-checkable per-site dependency witness containing selected square site, control bits, forward reads, dialog writes, reverse reads, restore site, and a proof that excluded bit-uses are absent. Then prove the transformed forward/reverse semantic stream and phase word equal on the card's finite selftest domain before relying on TLM_STRADDLE_VERIFY. Four 9,024-shot checks, unchanged Q, paired lambda, candidate compressed/canonical hashes, and strictly lower S remain promotion obligations, not scout evidence.

composite_card.cheapest_discriminator: A default-off, TRACE-only isolated implementer probe (TLM_SQ_REPLAY_FTERM_MAP=1) that emits the per-selected-bit source-use map across square output, first forward divstep, dialog write, and reverse replay; plus the existing TRACE_TLM_TOF phase totals. It is positive only if at least one selected site has an existing paired restore point, zero prohibited uses, and an estimated deletion (not relocation) of >=500 emitted CCX. It must not run an evaluator, dirty scan, census, or grind.
staged_cheap_discriminators: D0 / read-only model: map each candidate f-term's control and target bit fanout from square exit through the first forward divstep, codec writes, and matching reverse replay; reject on any branch/predicate/tape/phase use not included in the paired restore proof.

D1 / isolated TRACE-only edit: TLM_SQ_REPLAY_FTERM_MAP=1, default off, emits source-site labels and phase-local CCX/Toffoli counts; verify flag-off compressed and canonical identities equal the frontier.

D2 / one mechanism only: TLM_SQ_REPLAY_FTERM_FUSE=1 transports exactly one certified site pair; require changed candidate hash, no new qubit id, no stale-key credit, and emitted deletion >=500 before selftests.

D3 / proof and light semantic gate: source witness + TLM_STRADDLE_VERIFY bounded selftest; inspect phase word and B0 windows at early walk, late tape walk, and square. This does not certify score or lambda.

D4 / later authorized gates only: paired dirty scan n>=12 against lambda=17.62, stream-specific strip re-mine or exact-certificate-only configuration, then full 9,024-shot evaluation and separately approved nonce work.
composite_card.predeclared_falsifier: Refute this direct no-retention transport mechanism if any selected f-term bit (1) is read by a forward branch/swap/compare, s2 predicate, dialog symbol, carry, phase operation, or final output before the proposed paired restoration; (2) needs a retained b_hi/product control, extra tape bit, widened cswap, or any Q increase at a 1,154-q window; (3) has no net emitted deletion >=500 after the one-site probe; (4) makes a selftest/straddle phase or value mismatch; or (5) creates stale strip loss at least as large as the local deletion without a source certificate. A fired falsifier refutes EXP-ARCH-06's stated transport mechanism only, not square algebra, codec construction, or the general walk/replay family.
